name: project-stampede-steam-alpha
spoken: أُعلن عن لعبة السباقات Project Stampede على Steam، وفيها تتسابق على دراجات ترابية وشاحنات عملاقة، من عشر فئات من المركبات. وتحيي اللعبة سباقات الأركيد القديمة حسب مطورها.

label: نظرة أولى

angle.hook: a racing game where ramming your rivals is how you progress ('aggression equals progression', Steam page)
angle.why_now: Directrix Productions opened the Project Stampede Steam page with its alpha trailer; first report Game*Spark 14 Nov 2026 05:18Z (trailer file uploaded to Steam 13 Nov ~19:37Z); no Arabic outlet has carried it
angle.what_it_means_here: players in the region who miss MotorStorm-era off-road arcade racers get a new PC game to wishlist on Steam; no date or price yet
angle.payoff: ten vehicle classes from dirt bikes to monster trucks, and the developer's stated aim: the arcade racers of the PS2 and PS3 generations

story_type_items.TRAILER OR FIRST LOOK: what the footage shows that is new: the alpha 0.1.6 build (dirt bikes, quads, buggies, rally cars, monster trucks, big trucks, takedowns, desert and canyon tracks); the actual Steam trailer 'Project Stampede Alpha 0.1.6 Trailer', credited «المصدر: دايركتريكس (Directrix)» (short form: the full name ran out of the safe zone at render 1) on every shot from frame 0

sensitive: none: vehicle takedowns and crashes only, no people hurt on screen, no weapons
decision_log: 0 cover: red off-road car racing at the camera at sunset, 28.62 to 29.22 (fo 0.33, the white car with rear text kept out of the window); the dirt-bike rider (20.22) was the first choice but his helmet sits in the headline band, so he moved to the bike line; 28.42 to 28.6 (a pink car with livery text) and 29.25 (POLICE text) avoided

1 car leaping the canyon 17.55 (0.85; the white flash at 17.0 to 17.5 avoided), 2 quads 10.0 (0.9; text the prerender read at 10.95 avoided), 3 buggy 7.3 (0.9; white frame at 7.0 and text read at 8.25 avoided; the festival at 8.4 to 9.4 dropped for sign text in the window): headline window, 3.25 s

4 to 9 trucks on the road 32.55 (0.95; the dark tunnel before 32.5 avoided), rally car past the chevrons 35.0 (0.6; white at 35.75 avoided), blue car in green smoke 25.7 (0.5; text at 25.21 to 25.66 and 26.25 to 27.37 avoided), jump 33.5 and canyon 34.25, sunset 30.8 (after the white at 30.5) under «أُعلن عن Project Stampede على Steam» (illustration: racing from the announcement trailer)

10 to 13 dirt-bike rider 20.22 (0.93; text read at 21.17 avoided; his head sits high in the frame and the line band is low, nothing over his face), dirt bike 13.75 (2.0; the banner frame at 13.45 to 13.7 avoided), monster truck head-on 24.05 (0.47), big truck 37.25 (0.5; the teal car with a number at 37.0 to 37.2 avoided) under «تتسابق على دراجات ترابية وشاحنات عملاقة»: each shot shows the vehicle the line names
14 card «فئات المركبات 10» over the trailer (ground_footage 32.55): the count lives only on the card

15 to 18 jump against the sky 22.0, bike into the tunnel 23.0, big truck in the canyon 38.15 (fo 0.3; the white at 37.75 to 38.1 avoided), a buggy tumbling after a takedown 19.15 (fo 0.45; the pink flash at 19.0 avoided) under «تحيي سباقات الأركيد القديمة حسب مطورها»: air and takedowns are the arcade beats; the last 2 s are the tumbling buggy (a picture, no card)

sound: one stretch of the trailer's own sound from 7.0 s (a loud synth score from 3 s to 43 s); the voiceover lines are at 4.86 to 6.54 s and 40.0 to 41.86 s (faster-whisper without VAD), outside the stretch (7.0 to about 27); the audio split keeps the music stem and each shot's own effects

reel_check.1 primary read in full: yes: Steam store page app 5552610 (about text and trailer list, read 15 Nov 03:05Z) and Game*Spark 14 Nov 05:18Z
reel_check.1 not already posted: yes: git grep stampede, directrix, motorstorm over newsroom/stories: none (ledger.py find crashes on a list folder, as on LoL and FreeStyle)
reel_check.1 older than 24h: n/a: first report 14 Nov 05:18Z, 37 h before the slot; no Arabic outlet carried it (rule of 9 Nov: still news at 24 to 48 h)
reel_check.4 subject named before pronoun, no line: yes: line 1 names the game; no line opens on و
reel_check.4 release verbs: yes: أُعلن عن (announced, no date); caption قادمة إلى الحاسب الشخصي عبر Steam
reel_check.4 names match names-ar: yes: Directrix Productions added as دايركتريكس برودكشنز (Proposed)
reel_check.5 headline: yes: «لعبة سباقات تكافئك على صدم منافسيك», the hook fact, opens on an Arabic word
reel_check.5 caption: yes: first five words carry لعبة السباقات Project Stampede and the news word
reel_check.5 X and Threads: yes: one sentence, source «حسب صفحة اللعبة على Steam», no hashtags
reel_check.5 urgency: yes: chip نظرة أولى (first look at an alpha trailer), not عاجل; «ولم يُعلن موعد صدورها بعد» in the caption
reel_check.6 sound: yes: the trailer's own sound, one stretch from 7.0 s, audio split
reel_check.6 no narration under lines: yes: whisper (no VAD) hears speech only at 4.86 to 6.54 and 40.0 to 41.86 s, both outside the stretch
reel_check.7 footage first: yes: the official Steam trailer, 1920x1080 at 60 fps, 5.8 Mbps, decode clean (server shots mode 15 Nov 03:01Z), 9:16 crop enlarged 1.78x
reel_check.7 not the same picture as last 5 Reels: yes: picture: an off-road racer in a red desert; none of the last five Reels
reel_check.7 crop: yes: focus set per shot from 9:16 crops at 8 fps
reel_check.7 headline not over a face: yes: the cover is a red car racing at the camera (no face); the rider's head (shot 10) sits high, under no text (lines are low)
reel_check.7 credit on every clip: yes: one credit 0 to 18 (card span included) with from_start
